en: Ezekiel 4

p.src: 1  “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

en: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
u.src: 1  “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

p.src: 2  Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

en: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.
u.src: 2  Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

p.src: 3  Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

ja: され、あなたはこれを攻め
む。これはイスラエルの
en: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
u.src: 3  Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

p.src: 4  “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

en: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
u.src: 4  “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

p.src: 5  For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

ja: としてあなたに定めた。すなわち
である。こうして、あなたはイスラエルの
en: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
u.src: 5  For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

p.src: 6  “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

ja: え。わたしは一年を一日として、四十日をあなたに
en: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.
u.src: 6  “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

p.src: 7  You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

ja: あなたは顔をエルサレムの包囲に
en: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.
u.src: 7  You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

p.src: 8  Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.

ja: えるまで、脇を一方から他方へ変えることができない。
en: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.
u.src: 8  Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.

p.src: 9  “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

ja: れ。あなたが脇を下にして
en: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.
u.src: 9  “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

p.src: 10  Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.

ja: シェケル を量って食べよ。決められた
en: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.
u.src: 10  Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.

ja: 4:10 一シェケルは約10グラム、あるいは約0.35オンスである。
en: 4:10 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.

p.src: 11  You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

en: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.
u.src: 11  You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

ja: 4:11 一ヒンは約6.5リットル、または1.7ガロンである。
en: 4:11 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons.

p.src: 12  You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

ja: で、人の糞を燃料として
en: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”
u.src: 12  You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

p.src: 13  The LORD said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”

ja: われた。「このように、イスラエルの
らは、わたしが追いやる国々の間で、
en: The LORD said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”
u.src: 13  The LORD said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”

p.src: 14  Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”

にしたこともありません。」
en: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”
u.src: 14  Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”

p.src: 15  Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”

ja: える。それを燃料としてパンを
en: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”
u.src: 15  Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”
